title: Farrow Rate Converter
text: Polynomial sample-rate converter, 4 inputs, 3 outputs, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for type-casting the output; {Rate change source} sets the source of rate, {Rate change (fsin/fsout)} sets the rate change factor, {Coefficients matrix} sets the fIR filter coefficients, {Filter structure} sets the hDL filter architecture Direct form, {Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples} sets the serialization requirement for input timing, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow handling for type-casting, {Coefficients} sets the data type of filter coefficients, {RateChange} sets the data type of rate change factor fixdt, {Multiplicand} sets the data type of multiplicand, {Output} sets the data type of filter output, {Enable reset input port} sets the option to enable reset input port and {Use HDL global reset} sets the option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Input data real or complex scalar

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Filtered output data real or complex scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Indicates block is ready for new input data scalar

params.name: Rate change source
params.values: Source of rate change Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Rate change (fsin/fsout)
params.values: Rate change factor 147/160 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Coefficients matrix
params.values: FIR filter coefficients [-1/6 1/2 -1/3 0;1/2 -1 -1/2 1;-1/2 1/2 1 0;1/6 0 -1/6 0] (default) | matrix of real values

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: HDL filter architecture Direct form systolic (default) | Direct form transposed

params.name: Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples
params.values: Serialization requirement for input timing 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for type-casting the output Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow handling for type-casting the output off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Data type of filter coefficients Inherit: Same word length as input (default) |

params.name: RateChange
params.values: Data type of rate change factor fixdt(0,16) (default) |

params.name: Multiplicand
params.values: Data type of multiplicand Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) |

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of filter output Inherit: Same as first input (default) |

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: Option to enable reset input port off (default) | on

params.name: Use HDL global reset
params.values: Option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset signal off (default) | on
